page.overview:
Who is Hazel?

Hazel is a main antagonist of Lonely Freddy, the second story in Fazbear Frights 2: Fetch. She is Alec's nice younger sister who just wants to get along with her older brother and devises a plan so they can work together and get along.

Hazel has fine blonde ringlets that are twisted up in stiff bows. She also has evenly spaced freckles, straight teeth, and light-green eyes.

Hazel is very kind and helpful, helping with chores at home and around her classroom. She is also rather skilled and smart, playing the piano well and getting straight As in class. Hazel is a very caring person, making sure no one feels left out during her birthdays and wanting to be close with Alec despite his hostile attitude towards her, which can make her shy and nervous around him. She tends to follow the rules even when by herself, but is willing to break them for Alec’s sake. Hazel also rarely cries.

Hazel was born in April and named after a beloved grandmother. After her birth, her parent's attitude towards Alec shifted based on her nice and sweat personality. Hazel was showered with attention and praise by her parents, but through eavesdropping she learns that they only do so out of guilt for worrying about Alec, even having moved closer to their aunt Gigi just for him. Hazel would do everything to get along with Alec, such as baking him cookies in her toy oven after their parents ignored his pleas for sweats, laughing at an unintentional joke he made during a camping trip he ruined by scaring her, and adding Alec's name to the card during Mother's Day after he forgot. Despite this, Alec would continue to coldly dismiss Hazel. She eventually takes notice of Alec's love of Freddy Fazbear's and the Yarg Foxy character. Eventually, Hazel decides to get Alec a Yarg Foxy plush and tells her parents that she wants one.
